components.name: Battery Pack
components.reasoning: The central storage unit for electrical energy in BEVs, always a separate assembly with its own supply chain.

components.name: Cell Modules (LCO or NCM chemistry)

components.name: Battery Management System (BMS)
components.reasoning: Controls cell charging, balancing, and safety features; a distinct component with its own design considerations and suppliers.

components.name: Thermal Management System (TMS)
components.reasoning: Regulates heat within the battery pack to ensure optimal performance and safety; typically procured as a separate component to enable flexible integration.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA or PPS)
components.reasoning: Provides environmental protection for cells and modules; although sometimes integrated into module construction depending on manufacturer practices.

components.name: Cooling System
components.reasoning: A separate component in the TMS that can be customized based on thermal profile requirements of different vehicle models.

components.name: Structural Frame (Bolted or Riveted)
components.reasoning: Supports and protects the battery pack; often integrated into the vehicle chassis or body structure and procured from specialized suppliers.

components.name: Connector Assembly
components.reasoning: Enables safe connectivity between the battery pack and other automotive systems; a distinct subassembly with standardized interfaces.

components.name: Cell Balancing Units (CBUs)
components.reasoning: Ensures even charge distribution among cells to extend lifetime; often provided as separate units due to their high reliability requirements.

components.name: Overcharge/Overheat Protection Device
components.reasoning: A critical safety feature ensuring the battery pack operates within safe limits; usually a separate component designed by specialized manufacturers.

components.name: Battery Cells

components.name: Battery Pack (module)

components.name: Cell Connector Modules
components.reasoning: These connect individual cell strings within the battery pack, providing necessary electrical continuity and ensuring even charge distribution.

components.name: Thermal Management System (coolant loop)
components.reasoning: This system circulates coolant to manage temperature during operation, a critical distinct component for ensuring safe battery performance and longevity.

components.name: Electronic Control Unit (ECU) or Battery Management System (BMS)
components.reasoning: This manages cell balance, prevents over-temperature, and monitors overall health of the battery pack, usually implemented as a discrete module.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (e.g., epoxy, silicone encapsulation)
components.reasoning: Provides protection against environmental factors like moisture and mechanical damage; often applied separately due to its chemical nature but serves a critical function.

components.name: Structural Mounts (racks or frames)
components.reasoning: These provide mounting points for battery cells and subassemblies, ensuring proper orientation and secure installation within the vehicle bay.

components.name: Insulation Panels
components.reasoning: Protects sensitive electronics from physical damage while allowing airflow; typically a separate component to ensure reliable insulation quality.

components.name: Safety Fusible Links (optional but recommended)
components.reasoning: Provides an additional layer of safety by melting in extreme conditions, though not universally provided it is advisable for high-performance vehicles.

components.name: Housing/Enclosure for Pack Assembly
components.reasoning: This protects the internal components from external elements and provides a neat appearance; often fabricated separately to accommodate various battery pack designs.
